parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Give five Islamic teachings which were revealed in the Qurʾan.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain how Islamic teachings were made clear by progressive revelations of the Qurʾan.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
To what extent do Muslims need to consider the whole Qurʾan for determining Islamic law
(shariah)? Explain your answer. 
OR

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Outline the use of secondary sources of Islamic law (shariah).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain the use of reasoning (͑aql) as a source of Islamic law (shariah).

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Compare the use of analogy (qiyas) and reasoning (͑aql). 
Section B
Answer EITHER Question 3 OR Question 4.
EITHER

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain the use of individual interpretation (ijtihad), giving examples.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
‘Individual interpretation (ijtihad) ends with the companions (sahaba).’
Do you agree? Explain your answer. 
OR

Compare interpretations of the Mahdi by Sunni and Shiʾi Muslims.
